tools.name: tempclock_list_workers
tools.description: List workers (name, employee id, site, department, status, dormant flag), or one worker by id. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/workers.php.

tools.name: tempclock_list_locations
tools.description: List sites (locations) the key can see, or one site by id. Use the ids in other tools' location_id filters. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/locations.php.

tools.name: tempclock_list_timesheets
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out time entries, or one entry by id. Default entry_filter=shifts returns completed shifts; active returns open shifts (on site now). Pay and charge figures are not included. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/timesheets.php.

tools.name: tempclock_list_shifts
tools.description: List shift bookings (worker, site, date, times, status), or one booking by id. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/shifts.php.

tools.name: tempclock_get_on_site_now
tools.description: Count and list the workers on site right now, per site or for all sites. Set include_workers=false for totals only. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/on-site-now.php.
